learnings.rule: Avoid @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, explicit any, and double casts (as unknown as T) to silence type errors; narrow or validate the data instead.
Validate untrusted JSON, IPC payloads, and API inputs at runtime with a schema instead of trusting TypeScript type assertions alone.
Handle all variants of discriminated unions exhaustively so adding a new status or event type surfaces missing branches at compile time.
